name: text-to-ansys
description: Reviewable ANSYS Mechanical linear-static simulation specifications, deterministic compilation, execution, DPF inspection, and reporting.

interface.longDescription: Turns ANSYS Mechanical linear-static requirements into a strict simulation specification, deterministic saved scripts, environment diagnostics, optional PyMechanical execution, PyDPF inspection, engineering checks, and reviewable reports.
defaultPrompt: Create a reviewable ANSYS Mechanical static-analysis specification.
Modify an exact-name Mechanical template and prepare a dry-run.
Inspect an ANSYS RST result with DPF and generate a report.
